notes.title: Patch 1.0.0.5 out
notes.notes:
Hello,

So sorry for taking so long with the update but due to problems with Game Maker we had to re-write the whole game engine and that took alot of time.

Anyway the game is now up to date and here are the patch notes:

[h1]Patch 1.0.0.5 (newest): [/h1]
- The physics engine is re-written. It's mildly different now, but it should work.
- You can now move Squishy and navigate the menu with WASD-buttons
- "Right click simulator 2k15"-bug is gone, sadly ;(
- Please report any bugs you find in the new physics engine

notes.title: Delay on the bugfix update
notes.notes: We've ran into some issues with the upcoming bugfix patch. There is still some work to do. We want to update the game to eliminate all the bugs, not just to cover a few of them. It's taking longer than expected, but it'll be ready soon. The patch should be arriving within the next 48 hours. Thanks for your patience :). The update also includes optional WASD-movement, as some players don't have arrow keys on their keyboard.

notes.title: Important fix patch out!
notes.notes:
Some really important fixes!

[h1]Patch 1.0.0.3 (newest): [/h1]
- Fixed Battle-Mode		
- Fixed Survival Mode + added online highscores		
- Fixed BOSS 3 and BOSS 4 achievements		
- Fixed Keys not saving on retry point		
- Axe debug keys removed		
- Speedrun debug key removed (SPACE)
